profile.name: Hearth Home Appliances
profile.summary: US maker of kitchen and laundry appliances (~2,000 employees, factories in Tennessee and Ohio). Sells refrigerators, dishwashers, washing machines and microwaves through big-box stores and its own website. Imports some parts from Mexico and Asia. No food, no medicine, no vehicles.
businessLines: Retail and online sales with product warranties
applies: DOE energy and water efficiency standards for home appliances
Consumer product safety rules and recalls (CPSC)
EPA rules on refrigerants and chemicals in products
Tariffs and trade rules on imported appliance parts
Factory workplace safety (OSHA) and labor rules
doesNotApply: Food, drugs, medical devices, aviation, banking
Energy rules for power plants, pipelines or utilities

product-standards.description: Energy efficiency, product safety, recalls, refrigerants

events.markdown:
# Regulatory triage — Hearth Home Appliances
Window 2026-11-09 → 2026-11-13 · as of 2026-11-13 · 1 items

## Medium (1)

- **Notice of Product Exclusion Extensions: China's Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer, Intellectual Property, and Innovation** [Federal Register]
  - Check whether any imported Chinese parts qualify for the extended tariff exclusions, and claim them on upcoming shipments to avoid paying extra import duties.
  - Deadline: 2027-01-09 (effective, quoted ✓) · Owner: Ken Adeyemi (Trade Compliance) · Areas: trade
  - 91 FR 72610 ✓ · https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/10/2026-22925/notice-of-product-exclusion-extensions-chinas-acts-policies-and-practices-related-to-technology
